sn45.155:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ākāse vividhā vātā vāyanti ||
sn45.155:1.2: puratthimā pi vātā vāyanti || pacchimā pi vātā vāyanti || uttarā pi vātā vāyanti || dakkhiṇā pi vātā vāyanti || sarajā pi vātā vāyanti || arajā pi vātā vāyanti || sītā pi vātā vāyanti || uṇhāpi vātā vāyanti || parittā pi vātā vāyanti || adhimattā pi vātā vāyanti || || 3.
sn45.155:1.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvayato a- a- maggam bahulīkaroto cattāro pi satipaṭṭhānā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti || cattāro pi sammappadhānā- || cattāro pi iddhipādā || pañca pi indriyāni- || pañca pi balāni- || satta pi bojjhaṅgā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti || ||
sn45.155:1.4: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno a- a- bhāvayato a- a- maggam bahulīkaroto cattāro pi satipaṭṭhānā || cattāro pi sammappadhānā || cattāro pi iddhipādā || pañca pi indriyāni || pañca pi balāni || satta pi bojjhaṅgā bhāvanā pāripūrim gacchanti || || 4.
sn45.155:1.5: Idha bhikkhu bhikkhave sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || pa [pe] || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.155:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno a- a maggam bhāvayato ā- a- maggam bahulīkaroto cattāro pi satipaṭṭhānā || cattaro pi sammappadhānā || cattāro pi iddhipādā || pañca pi indriyāni || pañca pi balāni || satta pi bojjhaṅgā bhāvanā paripūrim gacchantī
